notes.title: Mini Kingdom Wars UpdateV1.0.0
notes.content: [p]1. Add new difficulty \[extremely difficult][/p][p]2. Add new buildings such as the Demon Altar and Cannon[/p][p]3. Add a new online mode \[LAN Online], connect to the same network, enter the host's IP and port, and you can connect with friends locally[/p][p]4. Modify some bugs and some visual effects[/p]

notes.title: 迷你王国战争更新
notes.content: [p]1. Add one of three meat pigeons before each small game, with optional types including spells and profits[/p][p]2. Add localized languages for Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean[/p][p]3. Map update, currently two maps, namely rainforest and snow[/p]
